weapons.ability: Shoot in Combat, Anti-**^^WAR MACHINE^^** (+1 Rend)

abilities.effet: If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by a **^^Shoot^^** ability used by this unit, subtract 3 from that enemy unit's control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.nom: Grind Their Bones, Seize Their Skulls
abilities.effet: If any enemy models are slain by a **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit, after that **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved, this unit can immediately use a **^^Shoot^^** ability as if it were your shooting phase.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, or if it did not use a **^^Fight^^** ability last turn, the effects of the 'Blood-drenched' ability apply to this unit.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effet: Roll either 3 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of damage points this unit has. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

abilities.effet: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Mighty Axe of Khorne and Bloodflail** is 4.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effet: Roll 8 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effet: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly non-**^^Unique Blades of Khorne Daemon^^** unit to be the target.

abilities.effet: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks that target an enemy **^^Hero^^**.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Great Axe of Khorne** is 3.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.effet: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is **^^Infantry^^**, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on it.
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

abilities.effet: Each time an attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 8" of it after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved (and continue the attack sequence).

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
abilities.effet: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** to be this unit's quarry. You can pick a **^^Hero^^** in reserve.

abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effet: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield more than 6" from this unit's quarry and more than 9" from all other enemy units. If picked to be a target, the unit of **Flesh Hounds** must also be set up wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.declare: If this unit's quarry is on the battlefield, pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **Flesh hounds** unit to be the targets.

abilities.effet: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Flesh Hounds** unit, add 2 to charge rolls for this unit. In addition, while any friendly **Flesh Hounds** units are wholly within 12" of this unit, they can ignore the effect of the 'Beast' ability.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effet:
Both player's roll off. If you win the roll-off, pick a melee weapon that the target is armed with. Your opponent must pick a visible unit in their army within 3" of the target (they can pick the target's own unit, and even if it is a single-model unit).
Your opponent must resolve combat attacks for the target using the melee weapon you picked against the unit they picked.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 3" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.effet: While this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^Bloodbound^^** units, excluding **Wrathmongers** units, while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Mighty Axe of Khorne** is 4.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effet:
If the target is in combat with this unit when the target is picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability:
• It must pick this unit to be the target of the pile-in move (Core Rules, 15.3).
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made as part of that **^^Fight^^** ability against this unit.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effet: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for the target, roll 1 additional dice, to a maximum of 3, and discard 1 dice of your choice.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique Blades of Khorne Daemon^^** unit to be the target.

abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effet: Pick a friendly **Bloodletters** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by this unit and that friendly **Bloodletters** unit.

abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.effet: This unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.
While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Flesh Hounds** unit or a friendly **Karanak**, this unit's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

If the casting roll for an enemy **^^Wizard^^** within 12" of this unit contains 2 or more results of 1 or 2, the spell is miscast.
If the chanting roll for an enemy **^^Priest^^** within 12" of this unit is an unmodified 2, the prayer fails and its effect is not resolved. In addition, your opponent cannot give that **^^Priest^^** any ritual points for the rest of the phase.
This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage inflicted by **^^Spell^^** abilities and abilities used by **^^Manifestations^^**.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effet: Allocate 3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For the rest of the turn, add 1 to this unit's power level, to a maximum of 2.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effet: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **Bloodbound** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target.
abilities.declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature within this unit's combat range to be the target.

abilities.effet: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly **^^Bloodbound Infantry^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.effet: The target has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly **^^Bloodbound Infantry Hero^^** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.effet: For the rest of the turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, this unit has **^^Strike-first^^** but all of its combat attacks must target that enemy **^^Hero^^**.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.

abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effet: If an enemy **^^Hero^^** had any damage points allocated to it by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that **^^Hero^^** was destroyed this turn, **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of damage points this unit has.

abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.effet: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield in combat with the target and not in combat with any other enemy units.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** unit that used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn to be the target.

abilities.effet: If a friendly **^^Bloodbound^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effet: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of friendly **^^Bloodbound^^** units' melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
This unit can use **^^Unbind^^** abilities as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
abilities.effet:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit gains 1 ritual point.
abilities.declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) within this unit's combat range to be the target.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effet: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target's control characteristic, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.effet: Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle.
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly **^^Bloodbound Hero^^** within 8" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effet: If this unit is in combat, it can move 3". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move in combat.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You or your opponent declared the 'Eruption of Fury' ability for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.effet: Return 1 slain model to this unit. If your opponent declared that 'Eruption of Fury' ability and the unit using the ability is in combat with this unit, return 3 slain models to this unit instead.

If the unmodified charge roll for this unit is 8+:
• For the rest of the phase, this unit can pass through models in enemy units.
• Enemy **^^Cavalry^^** units passed through by this unit in this phase cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

abilities.effet: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.effet: Add 8 to this unit's control score while it is in combat.

**8+** Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks.

abilities.declare: If this **^^Manifestation^^** charged this turn, pick an enemy unit with a starting size greater than 1 that is in combat with this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effet: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the **blood tithe points cost** of the chosen ability, until the start of your next turn, the target can use the chosen ability as if it had been unlocked.
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Blades of Khorne^^** unit wholly within 8" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target. Then, pick a **^^Blood Tithe^^** ability that you have not unlocked this battle.

abilities.effet: For each part of this **^^Manifestation^^** that is within 8" of a **^^Wizard^^** (friendly or enemy), subtract 1 from casting rolls for that **^^Wizard^^**.

When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.
Each time this **^^Manifestation^^** moves, both its parts must end within 8" of each other. Each part of this **^^Manifestation^^** is armed with a **Stream of Molten Blood**.

While this terrain feature has an **Invoker**:
• Add 1 to chanting rolls for the **Invoker**.
• The **Invoker** cannot use **^^Move^^** abilities.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to the **Invoker**, measure to this terrain feature instead.
• All attacks that would target the **Invoker** target this terrain feature instead.
• If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the **Invoker**. Then, set up the **Invoker** on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer an **Invoker**. If it is not possible to set up the **Invoker**, it is slain.

abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.effet: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now an Invoker (see 'Words of Hate').
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature does not have an **Invoker**, pick a friendly **^^Blades of Khorne Infantry Priest^^** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase

abilities.declare: If this terrain feature has an **Invoker**, pick up to D3 enemy **^^Endless Spells^^** within 18" of this terrain feature to be the target(s) and make a **banishment roll** of 2D6 for each target.

abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effet: If this terrain feature has an **Invoker** that was not placed on it this turn, set up the **Invoker** on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer an **Invoker**.

abilities.effet: Roll a dice. On a 5+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost. This reaction cannot be used more than once per command.

Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Infantry Wizard Hero^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target

abilities.effet: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this **^^Manifestation^^**'s attacks.

abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effet: **Heal (3)** this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effet: **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.

abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.effet: Roll 10 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.declare: If this **^^Manifestation^^** charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effet: This **^^Manifestation^^** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this **^^Manifestation^^** passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of either part of this **^^Manifestation^^**.

When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.
Each time this **^^Manifestation^^** moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other.

When a number of damage points equal to this **^^Manifestation^^**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **^^Manifestation^^** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.effet: The next time the target uses a non-**^^Summon Spell^^** ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this **^^Manifestation^^** instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this **^^Manifestation^^** instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Wizard^^** within 3" of this **^^Manifestation^^** to be the target.

abilities.effet: This **^^Manifestation^^** cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this **^^Manifestation^^**.

abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.effet: This unit can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **^^Strike‑last^^** for the rest of the turn.
This unit cannot be set up in reserve and cannot be targeted by abilities that would remove it from the battlefield.

abilities.timing: Any Movement Phase
abilities.effet: Roll a D3. On a 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. On a 2+, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with the target's emberstone-enhanced weapon for the rest of the turn.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Hero^^** within this unit's combat range that has an emberstone-enhanced weapon to be the target.

abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.effet: Roll a dice. On a 3-5, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict D6 mortal damage on the target and its emberstone-enhanced weapon is destroyed. It can no longer be used in this battle and your opponent must remove it from their roster.
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that has an emberstone-enhanced weapon and is within 6" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.effet: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly units have **^^Ward (5+)^^** against damage points inflicted by emberstone-enhanced weapons.

abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.effet:
Roll a D3. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's emberstone-enhanced weapon.
• For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made with the target's emberstone-enhanced weapon, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **^^Attack^^** ability has been resolved.
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Hero^^** within this unit's combat range that has an emberstone-enhanced weapon to be the target.

abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.effet:

abilities.effet:

abilities.declare: This unit must be deployed using this ability.

from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **incognito**.
If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, set up the friendly **incognito** unit wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and not in combat.
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability if it is **incognito**. Pick this unit and a friendly **^^Infantry Hero^^** to be the targets. One target must be **incognito** and the other must be on the battlefield.

abilities.effet:

abilities.declare: Pick another friendly non-**^^Unique^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.effet: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, the targets' melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.effet: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **The Dread Mace** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.effet:
If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).

abilities.timing: Your Charge Phase
abilities.effet: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly **^^Destruction^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Spell^^** ability
