rules.effect: That **^^Asterism^^** ability can be used for the rest of the battle, but the others cannot, unless prophesied by the 'Further the Great Plan' ability
Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons for attacks that target friendly **^^Seraphon^^** units that are wholly within friendly territory.
Add 2 to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Seraphon^^** units.
Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **^^Seraphon^^** units.
**Heal (D3)** this unit.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a friendly **^^Seraphon Wizard^^** within this unit's combat range
rules.effect: Add D6 to the casting roll for that spell.

Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons. Add 2 instead if the number of damage points allocated to this unit is equal to or greater than half of this unit's Health characteristic (rounding up).
Add 2 to the Health characteristic of friendly **^^Seraphon Monster^^** units

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Seraphon^^** unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^Seraphon Wizard^^** to use this ability
rules.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
rules.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Skink Infantry or Skink Cavalry^^** units that are not in combat to be the targets.
rules.effect: Each target can move D6". Each target cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
rules.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Saurus^^** or **^^Kroxigor^^** units that are in combat to be the targets.
rules.effect:
For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
Ignore modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).
If this unit charged this turn, if a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'All-out Attack' command in the combat phase, no command points are spent.

Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Seraphon Cavalry^^** and **^^Seraphon Monster^^** units for the rest of the phase if they are wholly within 12" of this unit at the start of the move.

If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (D3) this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared the 'Further the Great Plan' ability
rules.effect: You can pick 2 different Asterism abilities instead of 1. They are both used in addition to the one you picked in the deployment phase.

rules.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**^^Monster Skink^^** unit that is in combat and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can move up to 8". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
Add 10 to this unit's control score while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^Manifestation^^**.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
rules.effect: Reduce your and your opponent's **fury levels** by up to 3, to a minimum of 0. You must reduce both players' **fury levels** by the same amount.

rules.declare: Pick any number of friendly **^^Seraphon^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit that have not used a **^^Move^^** ability this turn to be the targets.
rules.effect: This unit gains a number of **stored time points** equal to the number of targets picked. Then, if this unit has 5 or more **stored time points**, you can pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 18" of it. In your opponent's next turn, halve the Move characteristic of those enemy units. If you do so, this unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Seraphon Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Seraphon Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target's weapons until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Seraphon Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Seraphon^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target can use a **^^Run^^** ability and still use **^^Shoot^^** and/or **^^Charge^^** abilities later in the turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Seraphon Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Saurus^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Seraphon Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Seraphon^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of damage points the target has. For each 4+, **Heal (1)** the target.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Seraphon Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of them to be the target point, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Draw a straight line between the target point and the closest part on the caster's base. Roll a D3 for each unit (friendly and enemy) that has models passed across by this line. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Save characteristic, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit's **Companion** weapons.

This unit counts as a terrain piece for the purpose of picking targets for the friendly **Realmshaper Engine**'s 'Power Unleashed' ability. Do not inflict any mortal damage on this unit as part of that ability

rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
rules.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Save characteristic, apply the effect below.
Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 3+, the target has **^^Strike‑last^^** for the rest of the turn.
While this unit has not used a **^^Move^^** ability in the same turn, it is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away
No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** and **^^Cavalry^^** units by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit that has not been deployed.
rules.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the tunnels below**. It has now been deployed.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
rules.declare: You can use this ability if there are fewer than 3 friendly **Gnawholes** on the battlefield.
rules.effect: Set up a **Gnawhole** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all other terrain features.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Monster Skaven^^** unit that is not in combat and was not set up this turn to use this ability.
rules.effect: That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit that is **in the tunnels below** to use this ability.
rules.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Gnawhole** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Skaven Hero^^** wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: The target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Skaven Infantry^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
**Heal (D3)** this unit.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
rules.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Skryre^^** units to be the targets.
rules.effect:
Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:
**1 *Kaboom!:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
**2-5 *More Power!:*** Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
**6 *More-more Power!:*** In addition to the effect of 'More Power!', add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**^^Hero Moulder^^** units to be the targets.
rules.effect:
Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:
**1-2 *Self-destructive Fury:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
**3-4 *Rabid Infusion:*** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
**5-6 *Blinded by Frenzy:*** In addition to the effect of 'Rabid Infusion', the target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** until the start of your next turn.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
rules.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Pestilens^^** units that are in combat to be the targets.
rules.effect:
For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Verminus^^** units that charged this turn to be the targets.
rules.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets' melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

While a friendly **^^Skaven Daemon^^** is within the combat range of a friendly non-**^^Hero Skaven Infantry^^** unit:
• That **^^Skaven Daemon^^** has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **^^Skaven Daemon^^**, allocate 1 mortal damage on a friendly non-**^^Hero Skaven Infantry^^** unit within that unit's combat range after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for these damage points).

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit
rules.effect:
Pick up to 2 other friendly **^^Skaven^^** units that are not in combat and are wholly within 13"
of the unit using the 'Redeploy' command to be the targets. Each target must have at least one of the following keywords: **^^Verminus^^**, **^^Skryre^^**, **^^Moulder^^**, **^^Pestilens^^**, **^^Eshin^^**. After that 'Redeploy' command has been resolved, each of the targets can immediately use the 'Redeploy' command in an order of your choice without any command points being spent.

rules.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** to be the target.
rules.effect: For the rest of the battle, if the target has been destroyed, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Eshin^^** units.

rules.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** or **^^Unbind^^** ability for a visible **^^Skaven^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit
rules.effect: Add D3 to that casting roll or unbinding roll.

Each time an ability returns 1 or more slain models to a friendly **^^Skaven^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

rules.declare: Pick another visible **^^Skaven^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit and in combat to be the target.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit has **^^Strike-first^^** and the target has **^^Strike-last^^**.
Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **^^Skaven^^** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**^^Hero Skaven Infantry^^** unit:
• This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**^^Hero Skaven Infantry^^** unit within this unit's combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Moulder^^** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the turn.

rules.declare: Pick another friendly **^^Skaven Hero^^** on the battlefield with a Health characteristic that equals or exceeds this unit's Health characteristic to be the target.
rules.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• While the target has not been slain, friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
• Once the target has been slain, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

You can re-roll the random characteristic rolls for the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Skryre War Machines^^** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. In addition, each time a friendly **^^Skryre War Machine^^** wholly within 18" of this unit uses the 'Rolling Doom' or 'Whirling Doom' ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted, if any.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Bell of Doom** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Bell of Doom** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Vermintide** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Vermintide** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Warp Lightning Vortex** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Skaven Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up the first part of the **Warp Lightning Vortex** within 18" of the caster and visible to them, then set up the second and third parts exactly 7" from the first part and exactly 7" from each other so that they form a triangle.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, the target's melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 4+ instead.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skaven Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Skaven Infantry^^** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn

Pick 1 of the following brains. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn:
**Warpstone Addict's Brain:**
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks.
• This unit has a maximum control score of 1.
**Warlock Whelp's Brain:** Add 10 to this unit's control score.

If this unit was set up this turn, when making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by an enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique Slaves to Darkness^^** unit that does not already have one of the keywords below to be the target.
rules.effect:
Pick 1 of the following **Pledge to Chaos** keywords:
• **^^Pledged to Khorne:^^** 
• **^^Pledged to Tzeentch:^^**
• **^^Pledged to Nurgle:^^**
• **^^Pledged to Slaanesh:^^**
The target has that keyword for the rest of the battle.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique Warriors of Chaos^^** or **^^Darkoath Hero^^** to be the target.
rules.effect:
During the battle, the target gains **Dark Apotheosis** points as follows:
• Each time the target uses a **^^Fight^^** ability, it gains D3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.
• At the end of each of your turns, if the target is contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory, it gains D3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly unit with 8 or more **Dark Apotheosis** points to be the target.
rules.effect:
Pick 1 of the following.
***Aura of Chaos:* Heal(X)** the target, where **X** is the number of damage points allocated to the target. In addition, the target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** for the rest of the battle.
***Daemonhood:*** Set up a **Daemon Prince** within 1" of the target. Then, remove the target from the battlefield. If the target is your general, the **Daemon Prince** becomes your general instead and is added to your general's regiment. If the target has any enhancements, the **Daemon Prince** has those enhancements instead. If the target has a **Pledge to Chaos** keyword, the **Daemon Prince** has the same keyword. Otherwise, pick 1 **Pledge to Chaos** keyword for the **Daemon Prince** to have for the rest of the battle If any **^^Manifestations^^** that were summoned by the target are on the battlefield, those **^^Manifestations^^** are removed from play.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Pledged to Tzeentch^^** unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll 2D6. Then pick a point within a number of inches of the target equal to the roll. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units.
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^Pledged to Khorne^^** units.
Friendly **^^Pledged to Nurgle^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^**. If a unit already has **^^Ward (6+)^^**, it has **^^Ward (5+)^^** instead.

For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for friendly **^^Pledged to Slaanesh^^** units, you can roll 1 additional dice (to a maximum of 3), but if you do, you must discard 1 dice of your choice.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: The target has **^^Strike-last^^** until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. If the casting attempt is unsuccessful or if the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.
rules.effect: Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a **^^Wizard^^** within 18" of this unit
rules.effect: Pick a visible friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness^^** **^^Wizard^^** within 18" of this unit. After that **^^Spell^^** ability has been resolved, that friendly **^^Wizard^^** can use a **^^Spell^^** ability as if it were your hero phase, and the casting roll for that spell is equal to the casting roll for that enemy spell. Do not count that spell towards the number of **^^Spell^^** abilities that friendly **^^Wizard^^** can use this phase.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick 1 of this unit's melee weapons to be the target.
rules.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Inflict 3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, double the target weapon's Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
• Add D6 to the target weapon's Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
Weapons used for attacks that target this unit have a maximum Damage characteristic of 1.
Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy **^^Infantry^^** units while they are in combat with this unit.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: If the target does not have the 'Obscuring' terrain ability, it gains that ability until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a dice for each model (friendly and enemy) within 1" of the target. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that model's unit.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
rules.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Wizard^^** within 24" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target is picked to use a **^^Spell^^** ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target as a reaction. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that **^^Spell^^** ability.
Friendly non-**^^Warriors of Chaos Slaves to Darkness^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

rules.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **^^Darkoath Infantry^^** unit in combat with that enemy unit to be the friendly target.
rules.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.
• If there is a friendly target, return a number of slain models to it equal to the roll.
If a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Hero^^** with any **Dark Apotheosis** points is destroyed, give this unit 8 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
rules.declare: If there is a friendly **^^Darkoath Hero^^** on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-**^^Hero^^** non-**^^Unique Darkoath^^** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
rules.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.

While there is at least 1 friendly **^^Warriors of Chaos Hero^^** and 1 other friendly **^^Daemon Hero^^** or **^^Darkoath Hero^^** on the battlefield, add 2 to the control scores of friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness^^** units while they are contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **Daemon Prince** to use this ability. Then, pick a visible non-**^^Daemon^^** non-**^^Unique Slaves to Darkness^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Remove any **Pledge to Chaos** keywords the target has. Then, the target gains any **Pledge to Chaos** keywords this unit has.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
rules.declare: Pick an objective that is contested by any friendly units to be the target.
rules.effect: Place a **defiled token** next to the target objective. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting an objective that has a friendly **defiled token**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Warriors of Chaos^^** unit. Then, pick up to 2 visible friendly **^^Darkoath^^** units that do not have a **Pledge to Chaos** keyword and are wholly within 12" of that **^^Warriors of Chaos^^** unit to be the targets.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the targets have the same **Pledge to Chaos** keyword as that **^^Warriors of Chaos^^** unit.
Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly non-**^^Monster Slaves to Darkness Heroes^^**.
If this unit is picked as the target of the 'Eye of the Gods' ability, it gains 3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
rules.effect: This unit can use 2 **^^Fight^^** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

rules.declare: Pick each damaged friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
rules.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, **Heal (1)** the target. **Heal (3)** the target instead if it is a Monster.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Darkfire Daemonrift** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **^^Darkfire Daemonrift^^** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Eightfold Doom-sigil** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up an **Eightfold Doom-sigil** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Realmscourge Rupture** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Realmscourge Rupture** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

This unit has the **^^Pledged to Nurgle^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, attacks that target this unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

This unit has the **^^Pledged to Khorne^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks.

This unit has the **^^Pledged to Slaanesh^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, if this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.

This unit has the **^^Pledged to Tzeentch^^** keyword.
In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, this unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^** against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.
While this unit includes any standard bearers, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
rules.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of an objective you control and not in combat. This unit cannot use **^^Charge^^** abilities for the rest of the turn.

Remove all of this unit's **^^Pledge to Chaos^^** keywords. Then, pick 1 of the following **^^Pledge to Chaos^^** keywords. You cannot pick a keyword you picked for this unit earlier in the battle.
• **^^Pledged to Khorne^^**
• **^^Pledged to Tzeentch^^**
• **^^Pledged to Nurgle^^**
• **^^Pledged to Slaanesh^^**
This unit has that keyword for the rest of the battle.
While your **fury level** is 7, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's weapons.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Mega‑Gargant^^** that has not used a **^^Rampage^^** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** or **^^War Machine^^** that has a unit size of 1 and is within 1" of it to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the unit using this ability. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Mega-Gargant^^** or **^^Gargant^^** unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit that has not been picked as the target of this ability this turn and that is in combat with that unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

Each time a friendly **^^Mega‑Gargant^^** or **^^Gargant^^** model is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Mega‑Gargant^^** or **^^Gargant^^** unit that has not used a **^^Rampage^^** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy **^^Infantry^^** unit in combat with it to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. If the unit using this ability is a **^^Gargant^^**, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 6. If it is a **^^Mega-Gargant^^**, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 5+.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Mega‑Gargant^^** or **^^Gargant^^** unit that has not used a **^^Rampage^^** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
rules.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.
• Subtract 1 from save rolls for this unit.
Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **^^Sons of Behemat^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
This unit has a Health characteristic of 40 instead of 35.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Your opponent declared a **^^Charge^^** ability for a visible non-**^^Monster^^** enemy unit within 12" of this unit
rules.effect: If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, you can change one of the dice in that charge roll to a 1.
Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks that target an enemy unit contesting an objective you do not control.
This unit has Ward (5+) while it has 25 or more damage points.
This unit can use **^^Summon^^** abilities from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition as if it had **^^Wizard (1).^^**

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Run^^** ability in the same turn.
Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **^^Fight^^** ability has been resolved.
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic, Rend characteristic and Damage characteristic of this unit's **Almighty Stomp** or **Almightier Stomp**.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Combat Phase
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Sons of Behemat^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons while this unit is in combat with an enemy **^^Hero^^**.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for a friendly Mega-Gargant
rules.effect: Pick a friendly **^^Gargant^^** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique Sons of Behemat Hero^^** that does not have an artefact of power.
rules.effect:
Give that **^^Hero^^** 1 artefact of power from 'Titanic Trophies'.
**Designer's Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*
Friendly **^^Mega-Gargants^^** have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are within the combat ranges of any other friendly **^^Mega-Gargants^^**.
You can pick 2 friendly **^^Mega‑Gargants^^** or **^^Gargant^^** units that have not used a **^^Rampage^^** ability this turn to use the 'Jump Up and Down' ability instead of 1.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
rules.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **^^Mega-Gargant^^** units within 3" of any terrain features and pick any friendly **^^Gargant^^** units within 3" of any terrain features to be the targets.
rules.effect: Double the Attacks characteristic of each target's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn. If the target has no ranged weapons, pick an enemy unit within 12" of the target instead and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **Mancrusher Gargant** unit to be the target.
rules.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Gargant^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target and not wholly within 12" of any friendly **^^Mega-Gargant^^** units.

Roll a dice. On a 5+, this unit can use a Prayer ability from the prayer lore you picked during army composition as if it had Priest (1). Instead of making a chanting roll for that prayer, the chanting roll is 5 and cannot be modified.
This unit's melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage).
This unit has Ward (5+) while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly Mega-Gargant.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sons of Behemat Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Sons of Behemat^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect:
If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• Ignore the effects of the 'Battle Damaged' ability on each target.
• Each target has **^^Ward (6+)^^**.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sons of Behemat Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the roll. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any enemy models are slain by this ability, halve the target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sons of Behemat Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each target has **^^Strike-last^^**.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
rules.declare: Pick each friendly **^^Vampire^^** unit that used a **^^Fight^^** ability this turn to be the targets.
rules.effect: **Heal (D3)** each target. **Heal (2D3)** the target instead if it destroyed an enemy unit this turn using a **^^Fight^^** ability

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Deathrattle^^** or **^^Deadwalkers^^** unit that has not been deployed.
rules.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the grave**. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units **in the grave** than there are on the battlefield.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique Deathrattle^^** or **^^Deadwalkers^^** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
rules.effect:
Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^Soulblight Gravelords Hero^^**  or wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.
If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use **^^Charge^^** abilities this turn.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Soulblight Gravelords Hero^^** to use this ability, then pick up to 3 friendly **^^Deathrattle^^** or **^^Deadwalkers^^** units wholly within 12" of that Hero to be the targets.
rules.effect:
For each target:
• If the target is damaged, **Heal (3)** the target.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **in the grave**.
rules.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** and more than 9" from all enemy unit, or wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, wholly within friendly territory, and more than 9" from all enemy units.

If there is a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** on the battlefield, you can set up to 2 additional friendly **Cursed Sepulchres** on the battlefield. The first must be set up more than 3" from all units, objectives, and other terrain features. The second must be set up wholly outside enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features.
**Designer's Note:** *The original* **Cursed Sepulchre** *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the 'Deploy Faction Terrain' ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Soulblight Gravelords Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: The target has **^^Strike-last^^** until the start of your next turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Soulblight Gravelord Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit. If any enemy models were slain by this spell, **Heal(D3)** the caster.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Soulblight Gravelords Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons.
Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **^^Wizards^^** while they are within 18" of this unit.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
rules.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Cursed Sepulchres** on the battlefield, set up a **Cursed Sepulchre** on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy units, more than 1" from all friendly units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.
Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
rules.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **^^Deadwalkers^^** units in combat to be the targets.
rules.effect:
For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **^^Vampire^^** units that are not in combat and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly VAMPIRE units that charged in the same turn.

Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^Deathrattle^^** units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.
You can pick 1 additional target when using the 'Deathly Invocation' ability.

Each time 1 or more slain models are returned to a friendly **^^Soulblight Gravelords Infantry^^** or **^^Beast^^** unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **Belladamma Volga**, **Radukar the Wolf**, **Radukar the Beast**, **Ivya Volga**, **Lady Annika**, **Kritza**, **Torgillius the Chamberlain**, **Gorslav the Gravekeeper** or **Watch Captain Halgrim**, add 1 to the number of slain models returned to that unit.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** to be the target.
rules.effect: The target has **^^Ward (4+)^^** until the start of your next turn.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Infantry Vampire Hero^^** to be the target.
rules.effect: The target can move up to 12" and has **^^Fly^^** when it does so. It cannot end that move in combat.
Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

rules.declare: Pick another friendly non-**^^Unique Soulblight Gravelords Infantry Hero^^** to be the target.
rules.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while the target is on the battlefield:
• If this unit is a **^^Necromancer^^**, add 1 to this unit's power level.
• If this unit is a **^^Vampire^^**, add 1 to unbinding rolls for this unit.
• If this unit is **^^Deathrattle^^**, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.
Each time a **^^Manifestation^^** within 12" of this unit is removed from play, gain 1 **rage dice**.

rules.declare: Pick another friendly **^^Soulblight Gravelords^^** unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
rules.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+:
• If the target is not in combat, it can move D6" but cannot move into combat during any part of the move. 
• If the target is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Deathrattle^^** or **^^Deadwalkers^^** unit that has 2 or more models and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Add D6 to the target's control score for the rest of the turn.
You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit in your charge phase.

While a friendly **Deadwalker Zombies** or **Deathrattle Skeletons** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
• Add 2 to run rolls for that unit.
• Add 3" to the distance that unit can move when it piles in.
Each time an ability would heal exactly 1 or 2 of this unit's damage points, heal 3 damage points instead.
Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Hand of Nagash** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Soulblight Gravelords Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Hand of Nagash** wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Unholy Reliquary** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Soulblight Gravelords Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Unholy Reliquary** endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them, and more than 3" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Sanguine Swarm** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Soulblight Gravelords Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Sanguine Swarm** endless spell wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Sanguine Swarm endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique Stormcast Eternals Infantry^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
rules.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit that has not used this ability this battle to use this ability
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit's combat attacks and add 1 to save rolls for that unit.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit that is **in the Celestial Realm**.
rules.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: If there are more friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** units on the battlefield than there are set up in reserve, pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit that has not been deployed.
rules.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Celestial Realm**. It has now been deployed.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Subtract 5 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
rules.effect: This unit has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.
This unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** or **^^Priest^^** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect:
The next time this turn that the target uses a **^^Prayer^^** or **^^Spell^^** ability, instead of making a casting roll or chanting roll for them, you can use a value of 7 for the roll that cannot be modified. After that ability is resolved, if the target has any ritual points, reset their ritual points total to 0.
**Designer's Note:** *Ritual points apply modifiers so cannot be used with this ability to increase the chanting roll to more than 7.*

rules.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command or a **^^Rampage^^** ability for a unit in combat with this unit
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that command or **^^Rampage^^** ability has no effect, it still counts as having been used and any command points spent to use that ability are still lost.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, your opponent cannot control the target objective while they have no units contesting it.

rules.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy target, then you can pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the friendly target
rules.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn, while it is visible to this unit:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the enemy target.
• Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for the friendly target.

rules.declare: Pick 1 of this unit's non-**Companion** melee weapons to be the target.
rules.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Halve the Attacks characteristic of the target weapon (rounding up).
• Double the Damage characteristic of the target weapon.
• Attacks made with the target weapon score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 3+.
If an ability would heal or return any slain models to an enemy unit while it is within 6" of this unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Vanguard Chamber^^** unit that did not use a **^^Move^^** ability this turn and is not in combat.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ruination Chamber^^** unit.
rules.effect: That unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** for the rest of the turn.

Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Warrior Chamber^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly non-**^^Hero^^** non-**^^Beast Stormcast Eternals^^** units that do not have the **^^Warrior Chamber^^** keyword.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Extremis Chamber^^** unit that charged this turn.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sacrosanct Chamber^^** unit that had models slain in this turn to be the target.
rules.effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit.
While this unit is contesting an objective in friendly territory, add 3 to the control scores of friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** units contesting that objective.

rules.declare: If a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit was destroyed in the previous turn, pick a visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: The target has **^^Ward (5+)^^** until the start of your next turn.

Each time this unit is set up using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the battle round.
In addition, each time a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit is set up wholly within 12" of this unit using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.

rules.declare: Pick a visible enemy **^^Priest^^** or **^^Wizard^^** within 18" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

This unit can be picked to use the 'Their Finest Hour' ability even if it has already used it this battle. In addition, when this unit is picked to use the 'Their Finest Hour' ability, add 5 to its control score for the rest of the turn.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Celestian Vortex** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a Celestian Vortex wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Dais Arcanum** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a friendly Stormcast **^^Eternals Infantry Hero^^** that does not have **^^Fly^^** and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Dais Arcanum** within 1/2" of the target, visible to the caster and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and place it on the platform of that **Dais Arcanum**.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Everblaze Comet** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up an **Everblaze Comet** wholly within 18" of the caster.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Infantry^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 12+, this ability affects all visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** units wholly within 12" of the chanter.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: Heal (D3) the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals^^** unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then pick the closest visible enemy unit to them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target. If 2 or more visible enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy **^^Infantry^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Stormcast Eternals Wizard^^** to cast this spell, picka visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
rules.declare: Pick each friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** to be the targets.
rules.effect:
For each target, roll a D3 and pick 1 of the following effects:


• **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is equal to the roll.
• Return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to the value of the roll.

The **creeping overgrowth** is measured from each terrain feature that has a friendly **overgrown token**. The range of the **creeping overgrowth** is based on the number of friendly, **overgrown tokens** on the battlefield as shown:

• 0-2 **overgrown tokens**: 6"
• 3-5 **overgrown tokens**: 9"
• 6-8 **overgrown tokens**: 12"
• 9+ **overgrown tokens**: Whole battlefield


***Designer's Note**: Awakened Wyldwoods are your main way of generating overgrown tokens. Some unit abilities allow you to too.*

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and that is in combat with only 1 enemy unit to use this ability.
rules.effect: The unit using this ability has **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Hero Revenant Infantry^^** unit or friendly **Dryads** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
rules.effect: Setup a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
rules.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** on the battlefield, you can set up an **Awakened Wyldwood** on the battlefield more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 12" from all other friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** and more than 1" from all other terrain features.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit within the **creeping overgrowth** to be the target.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time your opponent declares a command for the target while it is not wholly within 12" of a **^^Hero^^** in their army, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as being used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Add 1 to the wound rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn, including attacks made with **Companion** weapons.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Run^^** ability in the same turn.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• The target cannot use **^^Run^^** abilities.
• Subtract 1 from charge rolls for the target.

The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a die. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. **Heal (D3)** this unit.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
rules.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
rules.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** units for attacks that target that enemy unit.

rules.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit's combat attacks this turn to be the target.
rules.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed.
While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** have **^^Ward (5+)^^**.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
rules.effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.
Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

rules.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a ^^**Spell**^^ ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
rules.effect:
• If this unit is not a **^^Wizard^^**, it can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**. Otherwise, it can use the 'Unbind' ability an additional time each phase.
• If this unit successfully unbinds the spell being reacted to and the caster is within the creeping overgrowth, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.

If this unit used the 'Eruption of Fury' ability this turn or you spent **rage dice** as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability when resolving the damage sequence for this unit this turn, give 1 ritual point to each visible friendly **^^Sylvaneth Priest^^** wholly within 12" of this unit.
Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.
When using the 'Endless Growth' ability, do not roll a D3 for **^^Monster^^** targets. Instead **Heal (3)** each of those targets.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks while it is wholly within 12" of the enemy general or an enemy **^^Warmaster^^**.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
rules.declare: For each friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit or friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** that was destroyed in the previous turn, you can pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit to be the target.
rules.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
In the 'Creeping Dread' ability, replace 'while it is not wholly within 12" of a **^^Hero^^** in their army' with 'while it is not wholly within 6" of a **^^Hero^^** in their army'.

rules.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** to be the target.
rules.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of another friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** and more than 9" from all enemies.

The first time each phase an enemy unit within the **creeping overgrowth** uses a command, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after that command has been resolved. If that command was a reaction, instead inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after the ability that command was a reaction to has been resolved.

If this unit is a ^^**Wizard**^^, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
If this unit is not a ^^**Wizard^^**, it can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it has **^^Wizard(1)^^**.

rules.timing: Once Per battle, Enemy Hero Phase
rules.declare: Pick a visible enemy ^^**Hero^^** to be the target.
rules.effect: Halve the target's Move characteristic the rest of the turn.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
rules.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**. Pick this unit and up to 1 other friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit. within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
rules.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Gladewyrm** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Gladewyrm** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Spiteswarm Hive** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Spiteswarm Hive** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

rules.declare: If there is not a friendly **Vengeful Skullroot** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
rules.effect: Set up a **Vengeful Skullroot** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, pick 1 of the following effects:
• You can **Heal (3)** the target.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick an enemy unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each time a target uses a **^^Move^^** ability and ends that move within the **creeping overgrowth**, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after that **^^Move^^** ability has been resolved.

rules.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **^^Sylvaneth^^** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
rules.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target(s) melee weapons.
Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic while it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**.

When resolving the damage sequence for this unit, if you spend **rage dice** as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability, you can re-roll any of the dice that determine whether damage points are removed from this unit's damage pool. After the damage sequence has been resolved, if you rolled a total of 10+ on those re-rolls, this ability has no effect for the rest of the battle.

rules.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the 'Endless Growth' ability
rules.effect:
If this unit is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**, for each target of that ability that is wholly within 12" of this unit, you can pick 1 of the following effects:
• When resolving that ability, roll a D6 for the target instead of a D3. If, as a result of another ability, you would Heal **(3)** the target instead of rolling a dice, **Heal (6)** the target instead.
• If the target is **^^Kurnothi^^**, instead of rolling a D3 and picking 1 of the effects of that ability to apply to it, you can return 1 slain model to the target unit.

Card — At the start of the battle, after using all Deployment Phase abilities but before determining which player will take the first turn, your opponent must pick 1 non-**^^Faction Terrain^^** terrain feature within their territory to be their **hideout**. The **hideout** cannot be removed from the battlefield at any point during the battle.

Affray — Master of Arms: 
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if the same enemy unit had at least 1 damage point allocated to it in 3 different phases this turn.

Strike — Break Their Defences: 
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control the enemy **hideout**.

Domination — No Survivors:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more enemy units were destroyed this turn and you control the enemy **hideout**.

Affray — Form a Wall:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more friendly units are wholly outside friendly territory, wholly within 6" of friendly territory and within 3" of each other.

Strike — Outpost Territory:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective within enemy territory and that objective is contested by:
• At least 1 friendly unit that did not use a **^^Move^^** ability this turn
• At least 1 other friendly unit that charged this turn.

Domination — Repel the Attackers:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are 3 or more friendly units within 3" of the centre of the battlefield that are not in combat.

Card — At the start of the battle, after using all Deployment Phase abilities but before determining which player will take the first turn, pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** on the battlefield or in reserve to be the **fugitive** for the rest of the battle.

Affray — Search Every Inch:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there is a different friendly unit wholly within each large quarter of the battlefield, those friendly units are more than 9" from the centre of the battlefield, and no more than 1 of those friendly units was set up this turn.

Strike — Quick Pursuit:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 1 of the following is true:
• There are 3 or more friendly units that are not in combat and are within 12" of the enemy **fugitive**.
• There is no enemy **fugitive** on the battlefield.

Domination — Bring Them In:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 1 of the following is true:
• There are 3 or more friendly units in combat with the enemy **fugitive**.
• There is no enemy **fugitive** on the battlefield and 3 or more friendly units are contesting the same objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

Affray — Daring Rescue:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if an enemy unit that was in combat at the start of the turn was destroyed by a combat attack made by a friendly unit that charged this turn.

Strike — Command from the Front:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are 2 or more friendly **^^Heroes^^** on the battlefield, all friendly **^^Heroes^^** are within 9" of a visible enemy unit and no friendly **^^Heroes^^** were slain this turn.

Domination — Hero of Legend:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective wholly outside your territory that you did not control at the start of the turn and a friendly **^^Hero^^** is contesting that objective.

Affray — Ambuscade:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more objectives or terrain features that you control, in any combination, are each contested by a different friendly unit that is more than 6" from friendly territory and was not set up this turn.

Strike — Surround the Enemy:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more friendly units that were not set up this turn are each within 9" of a different corner of the battlefield and wholly outside friendly territory.

Domination — Claim What's Yours:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are more friendly units within enemy territory than enemy units and there is at least 1 friendly **^^Hero^^** wholly within enemy territory.

Affray — Keep the Enemy Close:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective that is contested by at least 1 enemy unit.

Strike — Feign Weakness:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if more friendly units were destroyed this turn than enemy units.

Domination — Execute the Plan:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control each objective within enemy territory.
If an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, that attack scores 2 hits on the target instead of 1. Make a wound roll for each hit.

Unless otherwise specified, attacks made by this weapon are not affected by friendly abilities that modify hit rolls, wound rolls or weapon characteristics, except for those that apply negative modifiers (e.g. 'Covering Fire')

Add 1 to this weapon's Rend characteristic if the target has the keyword after 'Anti-' or fulfils the condition after 'Anti-'. Multiples of this ability are cumulative. For example, if a weapon has both Anti-charge (+1 Rend) and Anti-HERO (+1 Rend), then add 2 to the Rend characteristic of the weapon for attacks that target a HERO that charged in the same turn.
Add 1 to this weapon's Damage characteristic if the attacking unit charged this turn
If an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, that attack automatically wounds the target. Make a save roll as normal.
If an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, that attack inflicts mortal damage on the target unit equal to the Damage characteristic of that weapon and the attack sequence ends.
This weapon can be used to make shooting attacks even if the attacking unit is in combat.
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target a unit that is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless that unit charged this turn or has the **^^Fly^^** keyword.
Models cannot move across, be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.
A unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless it has the **^^Fly^^** keyword.

Models can move across but cannot be set up on or end any type of move on any part of this terrain feature that is more than 1" tall.
